snippet.title: Phoenix, Arizona: Climate History and Outlook
snippet.description:
Climate, Place-by-Place examines Phoenix, Arizona, US.

This episode distinguishes NASA POWER gridded reanalysis from station observations and compares three conditional CMIP6 model outputs. Model spread is not a probability interval or a deterministic prediction.

Historical evidence: 1981–2025. Conditional outlook: 2040–2049.

Sources:
• NASA POWER Temporal APIs: https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/temporal/
• NASA POWER Meteorology Methodology: https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/methodology/meteorology/
• NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 data access and subset method: https://www.nccs.nasa.gov/data-collections/nex-gddp-cmip6/
• NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 Open Data Registry: https://registry.opendata.aws/nex-gddp-cmip6/

This is educational climate analysis, not an emergency forecast, engineering design basis, or individualized risk assessment.

snippet.title: Chicago, Illinois: Climate History and Outlook
snippet.description:
Climate, Place-by-Place examines Chicago, Illinois, US.

This episode distinguishes NASA POWER gridded reanalysis from station observations and compares three conditional CMIP6 model outputs. Model spread is not a probability interval or a deterministic prediction.

Historical evidence: 1981–2025. Conditional outlook: 2036–2049.

Sources:
• NASA POWER Temporal APIs: https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/temporal/
• NASA POWER Meteorology Methodology: https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/methodology/meteorology/
• NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6: https://www.nccs.nasa.gov/data-collections/nex-gddp-cmip6/
• Open-Meteo Climate API: https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/climate-api

This is educational climate analysis, not an emergency forecast, engineering design basis, or individualized risk assessment.

Legacy pilot method and reuse note:
This episode uses NASA POWER reanalysis and three HighResMIP/CMIP6 models processed and bias-corrected by Open-Meteo, comparing 2011-01-01/2020-12-31 with 2040-01-01/2049-12-31.
Open-Meteo data are used under CC BY 4.0. Attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com — https://open-meteo.com/ — and the CMIP6 program.
This Chicago, Illinois pilot predates the channel's method-v2 direct NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 SSP5-8.5 standard. Its figures remain a legacy conditional comparison and are not the method-v2 series.
Creator monetization of this legacy episode is withheld pending a separate commercial-use admission.
